knowledge_reasoning: An intervention is not a request to reverse-engineer a more typical upstream cause. Directly stipulated events are set, and non-descendant background facts remain fixed.
prompt:
Story:
The lines in the airport were very long because a lot of people were traveling that day. Thankfully, John arrived at the airport early, so he did not miss his flight.

Counterfactual intervention:
Change this story to make lines at the airport short and John to miss his flight instead, keeping all other background factors in the story the same.

Treat the requested change as an intervention on the world described by the
story. Keep fixed all background facts that are causally upstream of the
intervention, along with any other story details it does not affect. Update
the intervened event and every downstream consequence it changes so that the
edited story remains causally consistent with the original context. Do not
make any other changes.

Return only the fully edited story.
